original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-proper-flat}
Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme.
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a morphism of schemes which is proper, flat, and
of finite presentation.
Let $a$ be the right adjoint for
$Rf_* : D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_X) \to D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_Y)$ of
Lemma \ref{lemma-twisted-inverse-image}. Then $a$ commutes with direct sums.
stage_b_review_note: At line 2613, the original lemma assumes f proper flat finitely presented over qcqs Y, and concludes a_f commutes with direct sums. The prepared familywise coproduct isomorphism is exactly this condition on arbitrary (not just finite) sums in D_QCoh.
statement: Let $Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $f:X\to Y$ proper, flat, and of finite presentation. Let $a_f$ be the right adjoint to $Rf_*$ on unbounded derived categories with quasi-coherent cohomology, and define the *relative dualizing complex* $\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}=a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. For every family $(K_\lambda)_{\lambda\in\Lambda}$ of objects of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ the canonical map $\bigoplus_\lambda a_f(K_\lambda)\to a_f(\bigoplus_\lambda K_\lambda)$ is an isomorphism. Thus the right adjoint to the derived pushforward preserves arbitrary coproducts, not merely finite sums.
hypotheses: f proper flat finite presentation over qcqs Y; a_f right adjoint.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-proper-flat-relative}
Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme.
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a morphism of schemes which is proper, flat, and
of finite presentation.
Let $a$ be the right adjoint for
$Rf_* : D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_X) \to D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_Y)$ of
Lemma \ref{lemma-twisted-inverse-image}. Then
\begin{enumerate}
\item for every closed $T \subset Y$ if $Q \in D_\QCoh(Y)$ is supported on $T$,
then $a(Q)$ is supported on $f^{-1}(T)$,
\item for every quasi-compact open $V \subset Y$ and any
$K \in D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_Y)$ the map (\ref{equation-sheafy})
is an isomorphism.
\end{enumerate}
stage_b_review_note: At line 2648, the pinned lemma has two separate unbounded conclusions: a_f pulls closed cohomological supports back, and its open restriction comparison is invertible for every QC open V and arbitrary K. The draft retains both assertions and the same proper flat finite-presentation premises.
statement: Let $Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $f:X\to Y$ proper, flat, and of finite presentation. Let $a_f$ be the right adjoint to $Rf_*$ on unbounded derived categories with quasi-coherent cohomology, and define the *relative dualizing complex* $\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}=a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. A complex in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ is *supported on* a closed subset $T$ if every cohomology sheaf is zero on $Y\setminus T$. If $V\subseteq Y$ is open, $U=f^{-1}(V)$, and $j:V\hookrightarrow Y$, $j':U\hookrightarrow X$, the *restriction comparison* is the natural map $\rho_K:(j')^*a_f(K)\to a_{f|_U}(j^*K)$. Then (1) for every closed subset $T\subseteq Y$ and every $Q\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ supported on $T$, $a_f(Q)$ is supported on $f^{-1}(T)$; and (2) for every quasi-compact open $V\subseteq Y$ and *every unbounded* $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$, the restriction comparison $\rho_K$ is an isomorphism. Both results hold without Noetherian assumptions on $Y$.
hypotheses: f proper flat finite presentation over qcqs Y; closed T and qc open V as stated.
conclusions: Support is pulled back and a_f commutes with restrictions to qc opens on unbounded D_QCoh.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-compare-with-pullback-flat-proper}
Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme.
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a morphism of schemes which is proper, flat, and
of finite presentation.
The map (\ref{equation-compare-with-pullback}) is an isomorphism
for every object $K$ of $D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_Y)$.
stage_b_review_note: At line 2674, the source says the previously defined comparison μ_{f,K} is an isomorphism for EVERY K in unbounded D_QCoh under proper-flat-finite-presentation conditions. The draft writes out the same derived pullback/tensor map with ω=a_f(O_Y) and keeps the full unbounded scope.
statement:
Let $Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $f:X\to Y$ proper, flat, and of finite presentation. Let $a_f$ be the right adjoint to $Rf_*$ on unbounded derived categories with quasi-coherent cohomology, and define the *relative dualizing complex* $\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}=a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. For a qcqs morphism $f:X\to Y$ with right adjoint $a_f$, let $\mu_{f,K}:Lf^*K\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}^{\mathbf L}a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\to a_f(K)$ be the canonical comparison obtained by adjunction from the projection formula $Rf_*(Lf^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}a_f(\mathcal O_Y))\simeq K\otimes^{\mathbf L}Rf_*a_f(\mathcal O_Y)$ followed by the counit $Rf_*a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\to\mathcal O_Y$. For every (possibly unbounded) $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ the canonical morphism
\[
Lf^*K\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}^{\mathbf L}\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}\xrightarrow{\mu_{f,K}}a_f(K)
\]
is an isomorphism. In particular, the functor $a_f$ is obtained by derived pullback followed by tensoring with the relative dualizing complex, functorially on the full unbounded quasi-coherent derived category.
hypotheses: f proper flat finite presentation over qcqs Y.
conclusions: Projection-comparison map is an isomorphism for every K in unbounded D_QCoh.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-proper-flat-base-change}
Let $g : Y' \to Y$ be a morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes.
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a proper, flat morphism of finite presentation.
Then the base change map (\ref{equation-base-change-map}) is an isomorphism
for all $K \in D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_Y)$.
stage_b_review_note: At line 2711, the source assumes arbitrary qcqs g:Y'→Y and proper flat finitely presented f, then concludes duality base-change is invertible for all K in D_QCoh(Y). The reconstruction retains the lack of finite Tor dimension on g, using f-flatness for Tor independence.
statement:
Let $Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $f:X\to Y$ proper, flat, and of finite presentation. Let $a_f$ be the right adjoint to $Rf_*$ on unbounded derived categories with quasi-coherent cohomology, and define the *relative dualizing complex* $\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}=a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. Given *any* morphism $g:Y'\to Y$ of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, form $X'=X\times_YY'$ with $g':X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to Y'$. Write $a'=a_{f'}$. As $f$ is flat the square is Tor-independent, and the canonical duality base-change map
\[
L(g')^*a_f(K)\longrightarrow a_{f'}(Lg^*K)
\]
is an isomorphism for all $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$. No Tor-dimension assumption is needed on $g$ beyond qcqs.
hypotheses: f proper flat finitely presented, Y/Y' qcqs, arbitrary g.
conclusions: The duality right adjoint commutes with arbitrary qcqs base change.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-properties-relative-dualizing}
Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme.
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a morphism of schemes which is
proper, flat, and of finite presentation with
relative dualizing complex $\omega_{X/Y}^\bullet$
(Remark \ref{remark-relative-dualizing-complex}).
Then
\begin{enumerate}
\item $\omega_{X/Y}^\bullet$ is a $Y$-perfect object of $D(\mathcal{O}_X)$,
\item $Rf_*\omega_{X/Y}^\bullet$ has vanishing cohomology sheaves
in positive degrees,
\item $\mathcal{O}_X \to
R\SheafHom_{\mathcal{O}_X}(\omega_{X/Y}^\bullet, \omega_{X/Y}^\bullet)$
is an isomorphism.
\end{enumerate}
stage_b_review_note: At line 2810, the original lemma asserts three properties of ω_{X/Y} for a proper flat finitely presented f over qcqs Y: relative perfectness, H^{>0}(Rf_*ω)=0, and O_X≅R SheafHom_X(ω,ω). The prepared statement retains the three independent claims and the definition ω=a_f(O_Y).
statement:
Let $Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $f:X\to Y$ proper, flat, and of finite presentation. Let $a_f$ be the right adjoint to $Rf_*$ on unbounded derived categories with quasi-coherent cohomology, and define the *relative dualizing complex* $\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}=a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. A complex $P\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ is *$Y$-perfect* if locally on $X$ it has finite Tor-amplitude relative to $\mathcal O_Y$ and is pseudo-coherent (equivalently is relatively perfect in the standard sense). Then: (1) $\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}$ is $Y$-perfect; (2) $H^i(Rf_*\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet})=0$ for every $i>0$; and (3) the homothety morphism
\[
\mathcal O_X\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet},\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet})
\]
is an isomorphism. These claims are about the derived relative dualizing *complex*, not necessarily a sheaf concentrated in degree zero.
hypotheses: f proper flat fp over qcqs Y; omega=a_f(O_Y).
conclusions: Relative perfectness, upper cohomological vanishing of pushforward, and derived self-Hom rigidity.

stage_b_review_note: At line 2941, the pinned lemma gives two individual O_X≅c(pr_i^*ω) identities and one ω≅c(pr_1^*ω ⊗ pr_2^*ω), where c is right adjoint of RΔ_*. The reconstruction retains both projections, the derived tensor on X×_Y X and the diagonal—not f—as defining c.
statement:
Let $Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $f:X\to Y$ proper, flat, and of finite presentation. Let $a_f$ be the right adjoint to $Rf_*$ on unbounded derived categories with quasi-coherent cohomology, and define the *relative dualizing complex* $\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}=a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. Write $X\times_YX$ for the fibre square, $\operatorname{pr}_1,\operatorname{pr}_2:X\times_YX\to X$ for its two projections, and $\Delta:X\to X\times_YX$ for the diagonal. Let $c:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X\times_YX})\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ be the right adjoint to $R\Delta_*$. Then there are canonical isomorphisms in $D(\mathcal O_X)$:
\[
\mathcal O_X\xrightarrow{\sim}c(L\operatorname{pr}_1^*\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet})
\quad\text{and}\quad
\mathcal O_X\xrightarrow{\sim}c(L\operatorname{pr}_2^*\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}),
\]
and
\[
\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}\xrightarrow{\sim}
c(L\operatorname{pr}_1^*\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X\times_YX}}^{\mathbf L}L\operatorname{pr}_2^*\omega_{X/Y}^{\bullet}).
\]
The statement uses the right adjoint for the *diagonal*, not for $f$ itself, and the two projections are taken on the fibre product.
hypotheses: f proper flat finite presentation over qcqs Y; omega=a_f(O_Y), c right adjoint of diagonal pushforward.
conclusions: Two pre-rigidity identities and a quadratic rigidity isomorphism for omega.
